page.overview:
Who is Kashike?

Kashike is a friend of Abiru, Tsuchino, and Tomari and used to play football with them around Sunagakure. After Gaara accidentally attacked them while trying to play with them, Gaara brought Kashike ointment to apologise. Kashike refused his generosity and called Gaara a freak. He remains scared of Gaara, and most other things to this day.

Kashike cares for his friends and, due to being attacked by Gaara one time, is a very frightened person. In the anime, he is shown to be a bit of a bully, as shown when he threw rocks at Shira because of his lack of skill in ninja arts.

Kashike has long messy dark-coloured hair which he held in a pony tail in the back and he has small black eyes. He wears a white tank-top like shirt.
